en: The image shows a black-and-white photograph of a scenic, forested village or small town set in a mountainous area. There are several chalet-style houses with pitched roofs and wooden balconies, surrounded by trees and steep hills. A dirt road runs through the foreground, bordered by a wooden fence, with a few figures walking along it. The image has visible damage, including a large tear and missing corner, giving it an antique appearance.
